# CurveBook

> CurveBook is a free, open-source biostatistics, nonlinear regression, and scientific graphing application for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs offline with zero telemetry and opens .pzfx and .prism data files.

CurveBook is written in pure Rust and dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0. It provides an offline desktop GUI, deterministic headless CLI (`curvebook-cli`), and local stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`curvebook-cli mcp`).

## Key Pages

- [CurveBook Home](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/): Overview, workspace screenshots, core pillars, and Beta release downloads.
- [Open .pzfx and .prism Files](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/open-pzfx-files.html): Open .pzfx and .prism data files offline on macOS, Windows, and Linux and export tables to CSV or CurveBook projects.
- [CurveBook on Linux](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/linux.html): Native pure-Rust biostatistics and nonlinear curve fitting AppImage for Linux (x86_64 and aarch64), Wayland/X11, headless CLI, and local MCP.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/faq.html): Quick facts and direct answers on licensing, file formats, offline privacy, platforms, statistical methods, and MCP automation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/privacy.html): Local-first architecture, zero telemetry, no outbound network connections, and no auto-updater.
- [Full Reference Compilation (llms-full.txt)](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/llms-full.txt): Single-file plain-Markdown compilation of the CurveBook summary, quick facts, and all hand-written reference guides.
- [Source Code & Releases](https://github.com/HauserGroup/curvebook): GitHub repository, issue tracker, and release packages.

## Documentation Manual

- [CurveBook Reference Manual](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/index.html): Section map and typed reference manual for CurveBook statistical analyses, curve fitting, graphics, MCP, and CLI automation.
- [Get Started](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/get-started.html): System requirements, installing CurveBook, verifying checksums/attestations, and font configuration.
- [Desktop GUI Overview](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/desktop-gui.html): Overview of desktop welcome workflow, sheets, analyses, graphs, saving, and exporting.
- [MCP Setup for Beginners](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/mcp-for-beginners.html): Configure an MCP client to connect to CurveBook and verify the connection.
- [Concepts & Reactive Pipeline](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/concepts.html): Project structure, five sheet types, reactive recalculation pipeline, exclusions, checkpoints, and undo.
- [Data Tables, Formulas & Transforms](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/tables.html): Table archetypes, replicate subcolumn modes, Calculated Variables formula language, and data transforms.
- [Statistical Analyses Reference](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/analyses.html): Complete interface-neutral reference for every CurveBook statistical analysis kind, options, diagnostics, and citations.
- [Curve Fitting Reference](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/fitting.html): Nonlinear regression methods, equation library, weighting, robust/ROUT fitting, bands, custom DSL, and ODE models.
- [Graphs & Page Layouts](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/graphs.html): Graph types, compatible table archetypes, axis scales, error bars, colour palettes, and Page Layout rendering.
- [Calculators & Quality-of-Life Tools](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/qol.html): Scientific calculators, quick statistics, and workspace quality-of-life capabilities.
- [Files, Import & Export](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/files.html): CurveBook archives, unpacked .curvebook.d directories, templates, autosave recovery, and interchange formats.
- [MCP Server Reference](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/automation/mcp.html): CurveBook Model Context Protocol server transports, core tools, toolsets, resources, and prompts.
- [CLI Reference (curvebook-cli)](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/automation/cli.html): Headless runner subcommands, schema-typed direct command flags, exit codes, and PDF/format flags.
- [Control Protocol, Batch Format & Errors](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/automation/control-and-batch.html): Loopback --control JSON-lines protocol, curvebook.batch.v1 manifests, run scripts, and engine error codes.
- [Settings & Languages](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/settings.html): Preferences JSON Schema keys, keyboard shortcut customization, interface locales, and locale formatting.
- [Privacy, Licences & Security](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/privacy-security.html): Zero-telemetry local execution, loopback control rules, dual licensing, and vulnerability reporting.
- [Troubleshooting & Known Issues](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/troubleshooting.html): Common install, font discovery, MCP transport, archive recovery, and solver diagnostics.
- [Glossary](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/glossary.html): Definitions of core CurveBook scientific, data-model, and automation terms.
- [Tables, Analyses & Error Codes Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/tables.html): Live typed registry of table archetypes, subcolumn modes, analysis kinds, and engine error codes.
- [Parametric Equations & Fitting Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/equations.html): Live typed registry of built-in nonlinear regression equations, parameters, and constraints.
- [Graphs, Scales & Palettes Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/graphs.html): Live typed registry of graph kinds, axis scales, error bar options, palettes, and layout features.
- [Formats & Schemas Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/formats.html): Live typed registry of supported import/export formats, archive schemas, and user preference keys.
- [Engine & UI Commands Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/commands.html): Live typed registry of CurveBook engine commands and desktop UI actions.
- [MCP Tools, Resources & Prompts Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/mcp-tools.html): Live typed registry of CurveBook Model Context Protocol tools, resource URI schemes, and prompts.
- [CLI Subcommands Registry](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/registry/cli.html): Live typed registry of headless curvebook-cli subcommands and flags.
- [A–Z Reference Index](https://hausergroup.github.io/curvebook/manual/latest/az-index.html): Alphabetical index of CurveBook analyses, equations, graph kinds, tables, commands, MCP tools, CLI flags, formats, and preferences.
